tasks.subject: Task 1: Formatter pipeline + printer foundation
tasks.description:
**Goal:** FSFormatter turns source text into canonical text (default spacing, structural tab indentation), refusing on parse error, with full Node::Type coverage and faithful literals via a token index.

**Files:**
- Create: modules/foundry_script/fs_format.h
- Create: modules/foundry_script/fs_format.cpp
- Test: modules/foundry_script/tests/test_format.h

**Verify:** ./bin/godot.* --headless --test --test-suite="*Format*"

```json:metadata
{"files": ["modules/foundry_script/fs_format.h", "modules/foundry_script/fs_format.cpp", "modules/foundry_script/tests/test_format.h"], "verifyCommand": "./bin/godot.linuxbsd.editor.dev.x86_64 --headless --test --test-suite=\"*Format*\"", "acceptanceCriteria": ["format() returns canonical text or file:line:col error with empty output", "tab indentation derived from tree depth only", "every Node::Type has a print routine; unhandled triggers ERR_FAIL in dev", "literals reproduce from Token.source via index", "fork syntax prints structurally (final/abstract/generics/traits/AsyncCallable)"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 2: Comment reattachment + blank-line normalization
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Interleave comments from the line-keyed map at correct indent and normalize blank lines.

**Files:**
- Modify: modules/foundry_script/fs_format.cpp, modules/foundry_script/fs_format.h
- Test: modules/foundry_script/tests/test_format.h

**Verify:** ./bin/godot.* --headless --test --test-suite="*Format*"

```json:metadata
{"files": ["modules/foundry_script/fs_format.cpp", "modules/foundry_script/fs_format.h", "modules/foundry_script/tests/test_format.h"], "verifyCommand": "./bin/godot.linuxbsd.editor.dev.x86_64 --headless --test --test-suite=\"*Format*\"", "acceptanceCriteria": ["full-line comments emitted before next node at its indent", "inline comments emitted as trailing two-space # comment", "comment-only files and trailing comments preserved", "blank runs collapse to one inside blocks; 2 between top-level defs, 1 between methods", "one space after # (preserve ## and #!)"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 3: Canonical style normalization
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Apply non-structural canonical style: double-quote normalization, trailing commas, redundant-paren policy (preserve v1), numeric casing, fork-syntax spacing.

**Files:**
- Modify: modules/foundry_script/fs_format.cpp
- Test: modules/foundry_script/tests/test_format.h

**Verify:** ./bin/godot.* --headless --test --test-suite="*Format*"

```json:metadata
{"files": ["modules/foundry_script/fs_format.cpp", "modules/foundry_script/tests/test_format.h"], "verifyCommand": "./bin/godot.linuxbsd.editor.dev.x86_64 --headless --test --test-suite=\"*Format*\"", "acceptanceCriteria": ["single->double quotes unless content has a double quote", "trailing comma in multi-line collections/args, none single-line", "numeric casing normalized (0xFF, lowercase 0x/0b/e)", "redundant parens preserved in v1 with locking test", "[T, U] / [T: Bound] / AsyncCallable spacing canonical", "no auto-wrap/auto-join"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 4: Wire --foundry_script-format CLI with check/write/diff modes
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Headless command driving the formatter over files/dirs/stdin with CI exit codes, registered like --foundry_script-generate-tests.

**Files:**
- Modify: main/main.cpp, modules/foundry_script/register_types.cpp
- Modify: modules/foundry_script/fs_format.h/.cpp (FSFormatterCLI)

**Verify:** echo dirty script | godot --headless --foundry_script-format - ; --foundry_script-format --check <dirty> exits 1

```json:metadata
{"files": ["main/main.cpp", "modules/foundry_script/register_types.cpp", "modules/foundry_script/fs_format.h", "modules/foundry_script/fs_format.cpp"], "verifyCommand": "./bin/godot.linuxbsd.editor.dev.x86_64 --headless --foundry_script-format --check modules/foundry_script/tests/scripts/format", "acceptanceCriteria": ["paths recurse for *.fs; - or no path = stdin->stdout", "default=stdout, --write/-w in place, --check lists diffs+exit1, --diff/-d unified diff+exit1", "parse errors print path:line:col to stderr, skip, non-zero exit", "all-formatted --check exits 0"]}
```

**Files:**
- Modify: modules/foundry_script/tests/test_format.h, modules/foundry_script/register_types.cpp
- Create: modules/foundry_script/tests/scripts/format/**

**Verify:** ./bin/godot.* --headless --test --test-suite="*Format*"

```json:metadata
{"files": ["modules/foundry_script/tests/test_format.h", "modules/foundry_script/tests/scripts/format", "modules/foundry_script/register_types.cpp"], "verifyCommand": "./bin/godot.linuxbsd.editor.dev.x86_64 --headless --test --test-suite=\"*Format*\"", "acceptanceCriteria": ["fixture runner compares input.fs->expected.fs byte-for-byte", "fixtures cover basics/comments/strings/collections/fork-syntax", "idempotency over whole corpus", "refuse-on-error over errors fixtures", "token-stream semantic preservation", "--foundry_script-generate-format-tests regenerates expected.fs"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 6: Precommit hook + CI gate
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Enforce canonical formatting in precommit and CI via --foundry_script-format --check.

**Files:**
- Modify: .pre-commit-config.yaml, .github/workflows/*

**Verify:** mis-format a .fs, confirm hook + CI fail; --write; confirm pass

```json:metadata
{"files": [".pre-commit-config.yaml", ".github/workflows"], "verifyCommand": "./bin/godot.linuxbsd.editor.dev.x86_64 --headless --foundry_script-format --check .", "acceptanceCriteria": ["local precommit hook runs --check on staged *.fs, fails on diff", "CI step runs --check over the tree, fails on diff", "binary path documented per repo conventions"]}
```
